description: Byte-offset edits against licensed original inputs. Unchanged vendor content stays in the original package.

edits.replacement:
input PL_PHY_RX_CLK, input [3:0] PL_PHY_RXD, input PL_PHY_RX_CTRL,
  output PL_PHY_TX_CLK, output [3:0] PL_PHY_TXD, output PL_PHY_TX_CTRL,
  output PL_PHY_MDC, output PL_PHY_RESET, inout PL_PHY_MDIO,
assign cam_hs=0;assign cam_vs=0;assign cam_rgb=0;assign cam_clk=0;assign cam_data_en=0;assign led1=0;assign led2=0;assign led3=1;

# UDW1 scoped GP/HP exceptions; retain legacy endpoints, exclude UDW1.
# Replace ONLY inherited GP<->HP whole-clock false paths in the candidate.
# Keep the original exception for every non-UDW1 sequential endpoint, including
# vendor IP/video logic. UDW1 is governed by its per-synchronizer and payload XDC.
set udw_scope_root U_window_ddr
set udw_gp_clock [get_clocks -quiet clk_out1_clk_wiz_0]
set udw_hp_clock [get_clocks -quiet clk_pll_i]
set udw_gp_all [all_registers -clock $udw_gp_clock]
set udw_hp_all [all_registers -clock $udw_hp_clock]
set udw_gp_legacy [filter $udw_gp_all "NAME !~ $udw_scope_root/*"]
set udw_hp_legacy [filter $udw_hp_all "NAME !~ $udw_scope_root/*"]
set_false_path -from $udw_hp_clock -to $udw_gp_legacy
set_false_path -from $udw_gp_clock -to $udw_hp_legacy

set_property PACKAGE_PIN U6 [get_ports FMC_HPC_GBTCLK0_M2C_C_P]; # WUJING BOARD
set_property PACKAGE_PIN U5 [get_ports FMC_HPC_GBTCLK0_M2C_C_N]
##set_property PACKAGE_PIN R6 [get_ports FMC_HPC_GBTCLK0_M2C_C_P] ## WUJING LITE BOARD
##set_property PACKAGE_PIN R5 [get_ports FMC_HPC_GBTCLK0_M2C_C_N]

puts "FMSH-->Current IP PATCH version is $::ip_patch::version,set userID to 32'h$::ip_patch::user_id "
	set_property BITSTREAM.CONFIG.USERID 32'h$::ip_patch::user_id  [get_designs [current_design]]

set device_part [get_property PART [current_project]]
if {[regexp {xc7z030} $device_part] || [regexp {xc7z100_jfmql} $device_part]} {
		set_property IS_ENABLED 0 [get_drc_checks  REQP-44]
		set_property IS_ENABLED 0 [get_drc_checks  REQP-46]
		set_property IS_ENABLED 0 [get_drc_checks  REQP-52]
		set_property IS_ENABLED 0 [get_drc_checks  REQP-56]
}
